title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-notes-2026-03-20-draft
notes:
Weekly ops sync prep (Wed 2026-03-20) - DRAFT

Attendees (planned): Jordan, Aisha, Michael, me (Samira) + on-call rotation check-in from Nate if available.

Agenda:
- Quick SLO snapshot (1a/1b/availability)
- Paging trends & on-call load (last 7d)
- Top incidents: INC-2026-03-17-1 (KV cache OOM), INC-2026-03-14-2 (model routing flappy)
- Postmortem status + next steps
- Risk review: upcoming deploys + capacity forecast
- Action items / owners / deadlines

SLO snapshot (from last full run 2026-03-19):
- API request latency SLO (p50/p95/p99): 85ms / 420ms / 1.1s (p99 slipped by 0.1s vs target)
- Availability SLO: 99.95% (rolling 30d) - within target but two small blips noted
- Error SLO (5xx rate): 0.12% (target 0.1%) -> slight breach windows around 03/17 incident

Paging trends (7d window):
- Total pages: 19 (week before: 12)
- Pages by category: infra 8, runtime 6, network 3, human-error/config 2
- Spike on 03/17 tied to KV cache OOM (INC-2026-03-17-1) caused ~6 pages in 6h
- On-call load: average pages per oncall-day increased from 1.7 -> 2.6
- Notes: paging fatigue flagged by Nate; propose temporary escalation policy tweak for non-prod noisy alerts

Top incidents (brief):
1) INC-2026-03-17-1 (KV cache OOM) - severity SEV2
   - Symptom: sustained memory growth on serving nodes, large batch of long-seq requests + cache thrash
   - Impact: elevated latency and 5xx for 30-45min; autoscale insufficient due to pod OOM restarts
   - Current state: RCA draft in SRE-4321, mitigation (cache-size cap + circuit breaker) in staging PR (#1284), rollout planned canary Fri 03/22
   - Open items: validate memory telemetry (Michael), add eviction metrics (Jordan)

2) INC-2026-03-14-2 (Model routing flappy) - severity SEV3
   - Symptom: occasional routing failures when primary model variant overloaded -> fallback thrash
   - Impact: small % of requests rerouted -> higher latency for those flows; no customer escalations yet
   - Current state: rolling routing policy change to increase fallback threshold in test group; need to monitor for quality regressions

Action items (clear owners + due dates):
- Michael: add per-pod heap & native memory graphs to SLO dashboard + alert if RSS > 0.85*alloc (due 2026-03-24) [linked SRE-4321]
- Jordan: implement eviction metrics and expose cache hit/miss by prefix to Datadog (due 2026-03-22)
- Aisha: draft temporary alert routing change doc for noisy non-prod alerts (proposal for the on-call rotation change) (due 2026-03-23)
- Samira (me): coordinate canary rollout plan for cache cap PR (#1284), confirm rollback runbook and added smoke tests (due 2026-03-21)
- Ops: capacity forecast update for Dedicated pool (Q2 commit) - ask Infra to provide GPU hours estimate (request to infra team, due 2026-03-27)

Prep notes for the sync:
- Bring the RCA draft summary (SRE-4321) and mark the 3 most-critical follow-ups so we don't drift
- Show p99 latency heatmap for last 72h and call out correlation with paging events (03/17 window)
- Quick demo of staging telemetry for eviction metrics if Jordan has it ready
- Prepare proposed temporary alert-routing YAML diff for non-prod noise (Aisha)

Discussion points / questions to raise:
- Is the temporary escalation policy acceptable for one 2-week window? (pros: reduce fatigue; cons: might miss real regressions in non-prod)
- Do we want to widen the cache cap canary to 10% traffic after small validation run? Or wait for full smoke test?
- Long-term: consider autoscaling strategy for memory-heavy workloads -> per-node mem autoscaler or buffer pool redesign? Add as backlog item for roadmap (eng-planning).

Notes to self (informal):
- Make sure to add the on-call feedback notes into the postmortem (mental health + cognitive load).
- Confirm Nate's availability for sync (he flagged limited capacity this week).
- Keep the meeting under 45m; heavy topics can spin up follow-up deep-dive.

Follow-up after meeting (template):
- Publish short recap + action items in #sre-weekly with owners + due dates
- Link updated RCA + postmortem once SRE-4321 is final
- Update SLO dashboard notes with any temporary threshold changes

Quick links referenced:
- RCA draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98765432 (SRE-4321)
- Incident ticket: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INC-2026-03-17-1
- PR for cache mitigation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1284

End of draft notes.
